title: SharpSkill: Tech Interview Prep, Flashcards & Mocks
excerpt: Ace coding interviews with 12,800+ real questions, flashcards & mock interviews across React, Node.js, Angular & 10+ stacks. Start free.
content_html:
Technical excellence,
from learning to interview

Understand your stack in depth. Train with real-world questions and ace your interviews with confidence.

Why choose SharpSkill?

Learn, review, practice. Everything you need.

Real interview questions

The actual questions asked in technical interviews. You know exactly what to expect.

Flashcards by tech

Key concepts of your stack, explained simply. Review and anchor your knowledge.

Code review

Spot bugs, security flaws and bad practices on real code. The key exercise of senior interviews.

Technical tests

Validate your knowledge on each technology. Know where you stand before the interview.

10+ technologies

React, Node.js, Spring Boot, Angular, iOS, Android, DevOps. Pick your stack and train.

Interview simulators

Practice with a timer and conditions identical to a real technical interview.

Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know before you start preparing.

What exactly is SharpSkill?

SharpSkill is a technical interview preparation platform for developers. You get 12,800+ real interview questions, flashcards, technical tests, code review exercises and interview simulators on React, Node.js, Angular, Spring Boot, Go, Rust and more than 10 technologies. The goal: understand your stack in depth and walk into interviews with confidence.

Who is it for?

For developers preparing a technical interview, whether junior, mid or senior. Whether you're looking for a first role, switching stacks or aiming for a senior promotion, SharpSkill adapts to your level and your technology.

Which technologies are covered?

Frontend (React, Vue, Angular, Next.js, Nuxt), backend (Node.js, NestJS, Spring Boot, Django, Laravel, .NET, Go, Rust, Ruby on Rails, Symfony), mobile (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter), DevOps and data (Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering). New stacks are added regularly based on user feedback.

How is it different from ChatGPT or a simple quiz?

Questions come from real technical interviews, written and validated by developers who've been through them. Unlike a chatbot that improvises generic answers, you train on verified content. Flashcards use active recall for long-term retention, code review exercises teach you to spot bugs and security flaws like in a senior interview, simulators recreate interview conditions with a timer and constraints, and progress tracking shows you exactly what's left to work on.

How much does it cost?

A free tier lets you try the platform with no commitment. Premium plans give full access to all 12,800+ questions, interview simulators and technical tests across every technology. Details are on the Plans page.

How do I get started?

Create a free account, pick the technology you want to prepare and start with flashcards or interview questions. You can jump into the simulators as soon as you feel ready to train in real conditions.

What exactly is SharpSkill?

SharpSkill 是一个为开发者提供的技术面试准备平台。 您将获得超过 12,800 个关于 React、Node.js、Angular、Spring Boot、Go、Rust 和 10 多种技术的真实面试问题、抽认卡、技术测试、代码审查练习和面试模拟器。 目标：深入了解你的技术栈并自信地参加面试。

Who is it for?

适合准备技术面试的开发人员，无论是初级、中级还是高级。 无论您是在寻找第一个职位、切换堆栈还是希望获得高级晋升，SharpSkill 都能适应您的水平和技术。

Which technologies are covered?

前端（React、Vue、Angular、Next.js、Nuxt）、后端（Node.js、NestJS、Spring Boot、Django、Laravel、.NET、Go、Rust、Ruby on Rails、Symfony）、移动（iOS、Android、React Native、Flutter）、DevOps 和数据（数据科学、数据分析、数据工程）。 根据用户反馈定期添加新堆栈。

How is it different from ChatGPT or a simple quiz?

问题来自真实的技术访谈，由经历过这些访谈的开发人员编写和验证。 与即兴提供通用答案的聊天机器人不同，您可以根据经过验证的内容进行训练。 抽认卡使用主动回忆来实现长期保留，代码审查练习教您发现错误和安全缺陷，就像在高级面试中一样，模拟器通过计时器和约束重新创建面试条件，进度跟踪向您准确显示还需要做什么。

How much does it cost?

免费套餐可让您无需承诺即可试用该平台。 高级计划可以全面访问所有 12,800 多个问题、面试模拟器和跨每种技术的技术测试。 详细信息位于计划页面。

How do I get started?

创建一个免费帐户，选择您想要准备的技术，然后从抽认卡或面试问题开始。 一旦您准备好在真实条件下进行训练，您就可以跳入模拟器。
